_: T319 store shots, THIRD SET (2026-11-18: the owner delegated the order and titles to Claude, "you can give them titles"). Each `scene` is a play-shots.mjs scene shot from the web app; `device: true` is a phone-only screen read from <raw>/device-<scene>.png (store-shots/device-ios.mjs, the iOS simulator; `cropTop` = its status bar as a fraction of its height); `compose` stacks real captures (crops from..to plus label bands summing to 1). `title` is the big line, `line` the small one: plain words, B.C. spelled so, no "we", nothing the app cannot keep, nothing that reads as official. Earlier sets are in this file's git history.
